q1_issues.issue: (Experiencer sk_claim_1 sk_subset_1) mis-assigns the matrix role: Experiencer is for a holder whose complement seals, while a speech verb with a control infinitive ("claimed to treat …") keeps its ordinary role, Agent.

The complement is nested as one term argument of Theme, i.e. sealed, but a control verb with a to-infinitive never seals — the complement eventualities are to be reified at top level and attached by Theme.

"those" is typed as a group of `person` with no human-only predicate or role as discourse evidence — "claim" admits non-human subjects — where the rule prescribes the `thing` fallback (statement 1 inherits the same typing).
"that kind of statement" is reduced to the bare kind `statement`, widening the prohibition to statements at large; the same widening is repeated inside the distribution rule at statement 15.

q2_gaps: "that kind of N" — a kind-level anaphoric restriction on an object NP; the instruction set covers pronoun, definite, one- and event-anaphora but gives no carrier for an anaphor whose referent is a KIND, so the restriction can only be dropped (which widens the claim) or the clause left out

a percentage-and-count restatement of one partitive amount ("55 percent, or 149") — the two-true-atoms restatement rule is stated only for MeasureBy on a scalar-change event, not for a partitive subset carrying both ProportionOf and Cardinality
notes: The concessive is handled correctly — surface head `Despite`, main clause first, the definite plural "the regulations" as a group witness with a licensed per-member distribution rule — and "specific diseases" gets the prescribed descriptive-modifier distribution rule, which the sibling item tierD-000243 instead dropped.
